high_level_description: The image is a meme that humorously depicts the internal thoughts or feelings of someone when they "heart" (like) another person's post on social media. The text at the top reads, "When I heart react your posts, this is what I'm actually doing..." The image is divided into two panels: Left Panel: A close-up of a hand holding a pink rose. The hand appears to be gently cradling the rose, with fingers wrapped around it. The background is dark, which makes the pink rose stand out prominently. Right Panel: Another close-up of a hand holding a pink rose
